settings_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
settings_add_device_desc: Add a passkey on another device, or on this browser.
settings_passwordless_hint: Enable passwordless sign-in (sign in from autofill, no username)
settings_passwordless_badge_title: Enables passwordless sign-in via passkey autofill
settings_pair_show: Show this to the new device
settings_pair_expires: Expires in {seconds}s · or scan the QR
settings_pair_intro: Generate a one-time code (or QR) to add a passkey on another device.
settings_email_intro: Optional contact channel. Not used for login. Link an address, then verify it to mark it primary.
settings_email_token_notice: Verification token emitted to the archeion log (paste it below) until SMTP is wired.
settings_linked_intro: Sign-in methods beyond passkeys. Link a provider to sign in with it; keep at least one sign-in method on the account.
settings_last_signin_error: Cannot remove your last sign-in method.
settings_provider_intro: Model providers your agents can use, kept in your account's vault.
settings_provider_copy_fail: Saved on another device; this browser's key cannot open it.
settings_provider_encrypt_lock_hint: Encryption is only available when signed in with a WebAuthn passkey.
settings_provider_plaintext_hint: Unchecked, the key is stored as-is; the server can read it.
settings_provider_encrypted_hint: Encrypted here in the browser; the server only stores ciphertext.
settings_provider_name_duplicate: A key with that name already exists.
settings_timezone_desc: IANA name used to render absolute timestamps. Leave empty for your browser's local zone.
